_readme: Radio asset registry for بيتنا فين؟. Read by the game at runtime (public/radio/registry.json): edit this file to swap audio, no code changes needed.
Each broadcast lists sources in order of preference. The game plays the FIRST source whose license.status is 'cleared' AND that has a 'file'. Anything else is never fetched or played.
Archival sources must stay 'pending' (file: null) until reuse rights are verified in writing. Do not add a file for an archival source before that.

airDate: the real historical date the broadcast aired. The game never offers a broadcast before its airDate. window 'same-day' = only on that exact in-game date (news, communiqués); 'any-after' = any in-game date on or after airDate (songs, recurring programmes).
Only genuine recordings are played. A broadcast with no cleared genuine recording stays silent and the player says so.

communique_1973_10_06_no1.title: البيان رقم ١ — القيادة العامة للقوات المسلحة
communique_1973_10_06_no1._note: Not reachable in the current timeline (game dates are 27–28 Oct, 3–4 Nov). Authenticity warning: Al-Youm Al-Sabea (11 Oct 2026) reports that the widely circulated recordings of the 1973 communiqués use the wrong announcers' voices; per that article the first communiqué was read on the General Programme by Abdelwahab Mahmoud. Only a copy with Maspero/National Media Authority provenance should ever be labelled authentic. The TEXT of communiqués is an official document (excluded from copyright, Law 82/2002 Art. 141) and can be used for subtitles.
